welcome.title: Welcome to Core Hub
welcome.intro: Choose how this computer works with Core Hub. You can change it later in Settings → This device.

remote.title: Connect to a hub
remote.body: Use a Core Hub that runs on a server. Your chats, agents and settings stay on that hub.

local.title: Run on this computer
local.body: The app runs its own hub here and uses Hermes Agent installed on this computer. Nothing leaves this machine unless you connect it.

remote.heading: Connect to a hub
remote.url_hint: The address you open Core Hub at in a browser, such as hub.example.com or 192.168.1.20:8080.
remote.pair_hint: On a device that is signed in, open Settings → Device connections → Pair. Open the link it shows on this computer, or paste the link here.

url.scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
url.credentials: Leave the user name and password out of the address; you sign in on the next screen.

errors.hub_unreachable: Nothing answered at {url}. Check the address and that the hub is running.
errors.not_a_hub: {url} answered, but it is not a Core Hub.
errors.pair_invalid: This is not a pairing link, or it has expired. Start a new pairing and try again.
errors.local_failed: The hub on this computer did not start: {message}
errors.local_stopped: The hub on this computer stopped ({reason}). Start it again, or connect to a hub.
errors.install_not_found: The installer finished, but Hermes is still not where it installs. Open a new terminal and run hermes --version, then try again.

dialog.pair_detail: A link asked Core Hub to pair with this hub. Continue only if you started the pairing yourself.

local.starting: Starting the hub on this computer…
local.no_hermes_title: Hermes Agent is not on this computer
local.no_hermes_body: The hub on this computer works with Hermes Agent, which you install once with Hermes's own installer. It goes into Hermes's own folder; Core Hub does not carry a copy of it.
local.installing: Installing Hermes… This can take several minutes.
local.install_command: This is what will run, from Hermes's site:
local.without_hint: The hub starts now; its agents show Hermes as not installed until you install it.

helper.pick_folder: Choose a folder to share with the local helper

consent.title: Program access
consent.question: Let an agent use {program} on this computer?
consent.detail_hub: An agent on the hub {hub} (profile {profile}) wants to use {program} ({tool}). The program runs with your account's rights. Every call is listed in Settings → This device.
consent.detail_local: An agent on the hub on this computer (profile {profile}) wants to use {program} ({tool}). The program runs with your account's rights. Every call is listed in Settings → This device.

updates.available_body: Open the download page to install it.
